name: megascenes-pumpkin-stencil
description: Create pumpkin carving stencils to print and trace onto your pumpkin: a spooky face, a black cat, a bat or a haunted house, in solid black shapes on white.

interface.longDescription:
Name what you want to carve and how detailed it should be: a grinning jack-o'-lantern face, a black cat on a moon, a haunted house with bats, an owl on a branch, with simple bold cuts, medium detail or intricate cuts for experienced carvers. You get a stencil with solid black areas to cut out on white, connected shapes with no floating pieces, centered in a pumpkin outline.

ChatGPT tells you what the stencil needs and creates it in your MegaScenes account when you ask. The stencil opens in the chat and stays in your library, ready to print, tape to the pumpkin and trace.

For families, teachers and anyone carving pumpkins at home or for a Halloween party.

Limitations: a stencil as an image file, without text; it does not turn a photo into a stencil. Designs are spooky and fun, never gory, and original, not characters or brands owned by others. Making a file needs a signed-in MegaScenes account and runs in it; nothing is made until you confirm. Not for sexual or adult content or for real people's likeness. Files are made by generative models and saved in your MegaScenes library.
capabilities: Simple bold cuts or fine detail
Return the stencil in the chat
defaultPrompt: A pumpkin carving stencil of a grinning jack-o'-lantern face, simple cuts
A detailed stencil of a haunted house with bats for an experienced carver
A stencil of a black cat sitting on a crescent moon

positive.prompt: A pumpkin carving stencil of a grinning jack-o'-lantern face, simple cuts. Tell me what it needs, but don't create it yet.
positive.expected_behavior: What one pumpkin stencil needs from the account. Nothing is created.

positive.prompt: A detailed pumpkin carving stencil of a haunted house with bats. Don't create it yet.
positive.expected_behavior: What one stencil needs. Nothing is created.

positive.prompt: Which models can make a pumpkin carving stencil here?
positive.expected_behavior: The pumpkin stencil models with their settings. Nothing is created.

positive.description: Make it after an explicit request
positive.prompt: A pumpkin carving stencil of an owl on a branch under a full moon, medium detail. Create it now.
positive.expected_behavior: ChatGPT says what the run needs and, once the person confirms, one job starts in the signed-in MegaScenes account; the status tool reports progress and, when it succeeds, returns the file link, which the result view shows.

positive.prompt: Which MegaScenes account am I signed in with?
positive.expected_behavior: The email and plan of the signed-in account. Nothing is created.

negative.prompt: Print my pumpkin stencil on 50 mugs and ship them to my office in Berlin.
Email my pumpkin stencil to my client at sam@example.com.
What is the capital of Portugal?

review.commerce_description: The plugin does not sell products or process payments. Making a file runs in the user's existing MegaScenes account; no purchase happens in the conversation.

publication.release_notes: First release: make the file in the connected MegaScenes account and get it back in the conversation.
